title: A Grammar of the Asante and Fante Language called Tshi (Chwee, Twi)
author: J. G. Christaller
orthography: Lepsius Standard Alphabet (1863) — uses ṅ (=modern ŋ), w̃, and under-dot/under-bar vowels (ạ ẹ ọ e̱ o̱) for ATR/tense-lax grades that modern Twi orthography collapses to ɛ ɔ etc.

djvu_text.fidelity: LOSSY ON SPECIAL CHARACTERS — the archive.org OCR engine has no model for the phonetic orthography and silently flattens ɛ->e, ɔ->o, drops ŋ, and removes all nasal/length/tone diacritics. Usable for English prose and section structure ONLY; never trust it for Twi orthography or sound.

page_images.leaf_mapping: grammarofasantef00chriuoft_scandata.xml (leafNum -> pageNumber); body page numbering restarts at leaf 33 = printed page 1
page_images.fidelity: FAITHFUL — recovers all special characters and diacritics. This is the source of truth for orthography/sound.

ingested.phonemes.jsonl: Part I ch.1 §1-4 (leaf 33-34): 10-vowel inventory + nasal/length diacritics + ṅ, with sound descriptions and reconciled IPA/modern-orthography mapping. verification: sourced.

pronoun paradigm §53-54 + verb TAM §172-173 (leaves ~50, ~80) -> grammar.jsonl, to source/tighten morphophon affix tables from recovered (not djvu) forms

note: SOURCED grammar reference for the grammar-rules + phoneme layers (never from model memory). Sam's bar: orthography carries the phonemes; recover special characters from page images, do not accept djvu flattening. Cross-language doctrine — applies to every scanned source.
